title: Patched Lighttpd core build requires manual Autotools bootstrap when the verified 1.4.84 release lacks configure
title_de: Gepatchter Lighttpd-Core-Build verlangt manuellen Autotools-Bootstrap, wenn dem verifizierten 1.4.84-Release configure fehlt
security_assessment: The source/bootstrap boundary is security-relevant because it executes an upstream-maintained script from caller-provided Lighttpd source. The remediation preserves the verified-source/patch boundary: only the disposable patched copy may be bootstrapped, the original source is not modified, an unsupported non-executable script is rejected, and configure must be executable before build. No exploit, secret exposure, privilege escalation, integrity bypass, package installation, or network behavior is claimed.
security_assessment_de: Die Source-/Bootstrap-Grenze ist sicherheitsrelevant, weil sie ein Upstream-gepflegtes Skript aus der vom Aufrufer bereitgestellten Lighttpd-Quelle ausführt. Die Remediation bewahrt die Verified-Source-/Patch-Grenze: Nur die disponierbare gepatchte Kopie darf gebootstrapped werden, die Originalquelle wird nicht verändert, ein nicht unterstütztes nicht ausführbares Skript wird zurückgewiesen und configure muss vor dem Build ausführbar sein. Es werden kein Exploit, keine Secret-Offenlegung, Privilege Escalation, Integrity-Bypass, Paketinstallation oder Netzverhalten behauptet.
security_invariant: After existing source validation and patch application, bootstrap may run only inside the disposable patched Lighttpd tree; it must preserve the original source, run no installer or network action, surface failures, and produce an executable configure before the core build directory is created.
security_invariant_de: Nach bestehender Source-Validierung und Patch-Anwendung darf Bootstrap nur innerhalb des disponierbaren gepatchten Lighttpd-Trees laufen; er muss die Originalquelle bewahren, darf keinen Installer oder Netzwerkschritt ausführen, muss Fehler sichtbar machen und vor Erzeugung des Core-Build-Verzeichnisses ein ausführbares configure erzeugen.
profile: Parent worktree ea3b48abab7940de49997a371f9117b409c05a2a with focused synthetic source controls; continuation validation reran the focused and documentation controls, but LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR remains unset and no caller-provided verified 1.4.84 source is locally available
summary: The verified upstream Lighttpd 1.4.84 release used by the patched-core route can lack generated configure. The previous builder immediately required executable configure after patch application, while the retained analysis demonstrated that task-local sh autogen.sh followed by the actual core and host build succeeded. The source repair now performs that upstream bootstrap decision automatically and narrowly in the patched disposable copy, with six real-script contract scenarios. The current continuation reran the focused, EN/DE, documentation, JSON, and diff controls successfully, but the promised absolute LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR is unset and no verified 1.4.84 source/archive is locally available for the mandatory real fresh/core/host/reuse proof.
summary_de: Dem verifizierten Upstream-Lighttpd-1.4.84-Release des gepatchten Core-Pfads kann ein generiertes configure fehlen. Der bisherige Builder verlangte nach Patch-Anwendung sofort ein ausführbares configure, während die aufbewahrte Analyse zeigte, dass ein task-lokales sh autogen.sh mit anschließendem tatsächlichen Core- und Host-Build erfolgreich war. Die Source-Korrektur trifft diese Upstream-Bootstrap-Entscheidung nun automatisch und eng begrenzt in der gepatchten disponierbaren Kopie, mit sechs Real-Skript-Contract-Szenarien. Die aktuelle Fortsetzungsvalidierung wiederholte die fokussierten, EN/DE-, Dokumentations-, JSON- und Diff-Controls erfolgreich, aber das versprochene absolute LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR ist nicht gesetzt und es gibt lokal keine verifizierte 1.4.84-Source/kein Archiv für den verpflichtenden realen Fresh-/Core-/Host-/Reuse-Nachweis.
observed_behavior: The analysis-only general-state run records a verified Lighttpd 1.4.84 source/archive whose fresh patched copy lacked executable configure. build_patched_core.sh blocked before configure, and the same source succeeded only after a task-local sh autogen.sh. The current builder formerly retained no automatic bootstrap branch.
observed_behavior_de: Der analysis-only-General-State-Run zeichnet eine verifizierte Lighttpd-1.4.84-Source/ein Archiv auf, deren frische gepatchte Kopie kein ausführbares configure enthielt. build_patched_core.sh blockierte vor configure, und dieselbe Quelle war erst nach einem task-lokalen sh autogen.sh erfolgreich. Der aktuelle Builder enthielt zuvor keinen automatischen Bootstrap-Zweig.
expected_behavior: After the existing copy-and-patch verification, the builder reuses an executable configure when present; otherwise it requires autogen.sh in the patched source tree, runs it there, and then requires an executable generated configure. An executable autogen.sh runs directly. A non-executable script is run through sh only when its first line is exactly #!/bin/sh or #!/usr/bin/env sh. Missing script, unsupported interpreter, bootstrap failure, or a non-executable generated configure must stop with a precise exit-77 diagnostic before the core build begins.
expected_behavior_de: Nach bestehender Copy-/Patch-Verifikation verwendet der Builder ein vorhandenes ausführbares configure weiter; andernfalls verlangt er autogen.sh im gepatchten Source-Tree, führt es dort aus und verlangt anschließend ein ausführbares generiertes configure. Ein ausführbares autogen.sh läuft direkt. Ein nicht ausführbares Skript läuft nur dann durch sh, wenn seine erste Zeile exakt #!/bin/sh oder #!/usr/bin/env sh ist. Fehlendes Skript, nicht unterstützter Interpreter, Bootstrap-Fehler oder nicht ausführbares generiertes configure müssen mit präziser Exit-77-Diagnose vor Beginn des Core-Builds stoppen.
impact: A clean patched Lighttpd core/host build is not reproducible from the pinned verified release without manual intervention. This is a P1 release-build boundary; it is not a demonstrated security exploit. The implemented local repair has focused proof, but the fresh real source/build control is still required before verified or closed status.
impact_de: Ein sauberer gepatchter Lighttpd-Core-/Host-Build ist aus dem gepinnten verifizierten Release ohne manuellen Eingriff nicht reproduzierbar. Dies ist eine P1-Release-Build-Grenze und kein nachgewiesener Security-Exploit. Die implementierte lokale Korrektur besitzt fokussierten Nachweis, aber der frische reale Source-/Build-Control ist vor Status verified oder closed weiterhin erforderlich.
preconditions: The caller supplies an absolute external LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR containing verified Lighttpd 1.4.84 source.
The existing patch application has copied the source into the managed external patched root.
The upstream source either includes executable configure or includes an autogen.sh that can bootstrap it with the available upstream-declared tooling.
reproduction: Use the pinned verified Lighttpd 1.4.84 source whose fresh extracted tree lacks executable configure.
Run make -C connectors/lighttpd check-lighttpd-patched-host with a private external BUILD_ROOT and absolute LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR.
Before this repair, observe the configure gate block; after the repair, observe autogen in the patched copy, clean core build, host build, and legitimate reuse on a repeat invocation.

evidence.command: Analysis run: observe the verified 1.4.84 source before and after task-local sh autogen.sh, then run the patched core and host path
evidence.result: The initial patched core build blocked because configure was absent/non-executable; after sh autogen.sh the core and host build passed.

evidence.command: Run the real builder against six isolated source-tree scenarios, generated-guide tests, documentation checks, shell syntax, and ShellCheck
evidence.result: Focused builder, four Lighttpd guide controls, full 21-test compiler-guide suite, bilingual docs, doc links, shell syntax, ShellCheck, JSON parsing, and diff checks passed in the continuation. The actual real-source fresh/core/host/reuse proof remains blocked because LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR is unset.

evidence.command: rtk proxy env TMPDIR=<private-run>/tmp BUILD_ROOT=<private-run>/build LIGHTTPD_MAKE_JOBS=2 make -C connectors/lighttpd check-lighttpd-patched-host
evidence.result: Prior retained target evidence: Make invoked the actual patched-core prerequisite, whose deliberate exit 77 stated LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR is required; the host phase did not run. It is not a real-source E2E result.
The required environment variable was unset. Targeted local searches found no supplied Lighttpd 1.4.84 source tree or archive; no network substitute was used.

root_cause: The Parent builder assumed an executable configure in its patched source copy even though the pinned verified release archive can omit generated Autotools output. Its earlier fail-closed gate contained no narrow bootstrap path between verified patch application and configure invocation.
root_cause_de: Der Parent-Builder setzte in seiner gepatchten Source-Kopie ein ausführbares configure voraus, obwohl das gepinnte verifizierte Release-Archiv generierte Autotools-Ausgabe auslassen kann. Seine frühere Fail-Closed-Sperre enthielt keinen engen Bootstrap-Pfad zwischen verifizierter Patch-Anwendung und Configure-Aufruf.
proposed_remediation: Keep the existing source/patch/hash controls. In build_patched_core.sh, reuse executable configure; otherwise invoke autogen.sh only in the patched copy and only under the direct or exact-POSIX-shebang rules, write bounded autogen.log output, and require executable configure before making the build directory. Keep the six scenario regression controls and generated English/German guide instructions. Do not add package installation, a network download, a generic guessed Autotools command list, chmod, ignored failures, or a weaker source-integrity control.
proposed_remediation_de: Bestehende Source-/Patch-/Hash-Controls beibehalten. In build_patched_core.sh ausführbares configure weiterverwenden; andernfalls autogen.sh nur in der gepatchten Kopie und nur nach Direkt- oder exakten-POSIX-Shebang-Regeln aufrufen, begrenzte autogen.log-Ausgabe schreiben und ausführbares configure vor Erzeugung des Build-Verzeichnisses verlangen. Die sechs Szenario-Regression-Controls und die generierten englischen/deutschen Guide-Anweisungen beibehalten. Keine Paketinstallation, keinen Netz-Download, keine generische geratene Autotools-Befehlsliste, kein chmod, keine ignorierten Fehler und keinen schwächeren Source-Integrity-Control hinzufügen.
acceptance_criteria: A present executable configure is reused without invoking autogen.sh.
A missing configure is bootstrapped in the patched copy, including an exact-POSIX-shebang non-executable autogen.sh, and then builds successfully from a supplied verified 1.4.84 source.
Missing autogen.sh, failed bootstrap, unsupported non-executable interpreter, and a missing/non-executable generated configure fail closed with precise diagnostics before core build output exists.
The original verified source remains untouched; no package installation, network action, hash weakening, chmod, or error suppression is introduced.
The generated English and German Lighttpd guides describe the identical bootstrap decision and a current guide regression enforces it.
A fresh real core and host build plus a repeated legitimate reuse run pass with the supplied verified source.
validation_plan: Provide or retain a verified external Lighttpd 1.4.84 source tree that reproduces the absent-configure condition without network acquisition.

Run a clean build-lighttpd-patched-core and check-lighttpd-patched-host under a new private BUILD_ROOT; retain raw stdout, stderr, exit code, patch manifest, autogen.log, and staged binary/host manifest evidence.
Run the same target again to prove manifest/configure reuse does not rerun autogen.sh.
Rerun the focused real-script bootstrap suite, compiler-guide target, bilingual documentation check, documentation links, shell syntax, and ShellCheck.
regression_tests: connectors/lighttpd/tests/test_patched_host_contract.py: existing configure, missing configure with non-executable POSIX autogen, non-executable configure, both files missing, autogen failure, no generated configure, unsupported interpreter, and repeat reuse
tests/test_compiler_guides.py: generated Lighttpd English/German bootstrap wording and command regression
legitimate_control_tests: An existing executable configure skips the bootstrap script.
A non-executable autogen.sh with exact POSIX shebang executes through sh without chmod.
A repeat build reuses the verified core manifest and does not run autogen.sh a second time.
A real fresh source build preserves patch identity, staged binary version, and required hook symbols.
dependencies: A caller-provided verified Lighttpd 1.4.84 source tree or separately approved verified archive extraction.
Only the Autotools commands declared by that upstream tree's autogen.sh and the environment it reports as required.
blocked_by: The promised absolute LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR is unset; targeted local searches found no supplied lighttpd-1.4.84 source tree or archive, and the current user forbids adding a network acquisition step.
The final clean core/host build therefore cannot yet prove that the original real failure no longer reproduces.
historical_id_collision: FND-PARENT-0090 cites a different, older F-GS-002 from the 20260802 analysis run for a HAProxy/libModSecurity dependency boundary. It is not a duplicate or predecessor of this Lighttpd finding.
residual_risk: The local remediation is intentionally not marked fixed, verified, or closed while the real clean Lighttpd core and host path lacks a supplied verified input. A future validation must preserve the source-integrity and patch controls and must not replace the required source with an unverified download or generic bootstrap command sequence.
residual_risk_de: Die lokale Remediation wird absichtlich nicht als fixed, verified oder closed markiert, solange dem realen sauberen Lighttpd-Core-/Host-Pfad ein bereitgestellter verifizierter Input fehlt. Eine zukünftige Validierung muss die Source-Integrity- und Patch-Controls bewahren und darf die erforderliche Source nicht durch einen unverifizierten Download oder eine generische Bootstrap-Befehlsfolge ersetzen.

history.detail: Implemented the narrow patched-copy bootstrap decision, six real-script regression scenarios, generated bilingual guide updates, and focused static/documentation validation. The actual host target was invoked but stopped at the intentional missing-LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR prerequisite; no source download or unsafe workaround was used.
history.detail_de: Die enge Bootstrap-Entscheidung in der gepatchten Kopie, sechs Real-Skript-Regression-Szenarien, generierte bilinguale Guide-Updates und fokussierte statische/Dokumentations-Validierung wurden implementiert. Das tatsächliche Host-Target wurde aufgerufen, stoppte aber an der beabsichtigten Voraussetzung fehlendes LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR; kein Source-Download und kein unsicherer Workaround wurden verwendet.

history.detail: The final focused builder rerun added explicit non-executable-configure and unsupported-interpreter controls to the six required scenarios. All 26 contract tests, shell syntax, and ShellCheck passed; the real-source core/host acceptance remains blocked only by missing approved verified source input.
history.detail_de: Der finale fokussierte Builder-Rerun ergänzte explizite Controls für nicht ausführbares configure und einen nicht unterstützten Interpreter zu den sechs erforderlichen Szenarien. Alle 26 Contract-Tests, Shell-Syntax und ShellCheck bestanden; die reale Source-Core-/Host-Akzeptanz bleibt ausschließlich wegen fehlendem zugelassenem verifiziertem Source-Input blockiert.

history.detail: The continuation reran 26 patched-host contract tests, four Lighttpd-specific guide controls, the full 21-test compiler-guide target, bilingual docs, doc links, shell syntax, ShellCheck, JSON parsing, and diff checks successfully. LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR was unset and targeted local discovery found no verified 1.4.84 source/archive, so no fresh/core/host/reuse E2E run, source fingerprint, or fixed disposition is claimed.
history.detail_de: Die Fortsetzungsvalidierung wiederholte 26 Patched-Host-Contract-Tests, vier Lighttpd-spezifische Guide-Controls, das vollständige 21-Test-Compiler-Guide-Target, bilinguale Dokumentation, Doc-Links, Shell-Syntax, ShellCheck, JSON-Parsing und Diff-Checks erfolgreich. LIGHTTPD_SOURCE_DIR war nicht gesetzt und die gezielte lokale Suche fand keine verifizierte 1.4.84-Source/kein Archiv; daher werden kein Fresh-/Core-/Host-/Reuse-E2E-Lauf, kein Source-Fingerprint und keine fixed-Disposition behauptet.
